title: phegopteris dryopteris var. robertiana
intro: Phegopteris dryopteris var. robertiana, commonly known as Robert's shield fern, is a variety of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe wounds and reduce fever. The therapeutic actions of Robert's shield fern include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as arthritis and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
